# SolvedBooks.pk

> Free solved exercises, notes and MCQs for Classes 1-12 across four Pakistani boards: Sindh Textbook Board (STBB), Punjab Curriculum and Textbook Board (PCTB), Balochistan Textbook Board (BTBB) and Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Textbook Board (KPTBB). 574 books live in Sindhi, Urdu, English, Arabic, Punjabi and Farsi mediums. Free PDF downloads, no sign-up.

- [Home](https://solvedbooks.pk/)
- [All books](https://solvedbooks.pk/books.html)
- [Blog](https://solvedbooks.pk/blog.html)
